summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of a private offering of $800 million aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes due 2036, issued at par with a 6.036% coupon. The notes were offered under Rule 144A/Regulation S to institutional investors and are rated BBB- by S&P and Fitch. They will trade on TASE UP. Covenants include limitation on liens and change-of-control repurchase obligation. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
